arabic text: AY LADLE HASAN KE MEHENDI HAI TERI AAYI
english translation text: OH THE BELOVED OF HASAN, YOUR MEHENDI HAS COME

arabic text: ARMAN BHARE DIL SE HAMSHEER NE BANAYI
english translation text: (THE MEHENDI) THAT YOUR SISTER HAS MADE WITH LOTS OF HOPE AND DESIRE

arabic text: QAASAM BANE HAI DULHA KEHNE LAGEE SAKINA
english translation text: SAKINA SAID, QASIM HAS BECOME A GROOM

arabic text: AFSOS TUMHE BHAIYA SUGHRA NA DEIKH PAEE
english translation text: ALAS SUGHRA COULDN’T SEE YOU LIKE THIS

arabic text: MITHI ME MIL RAHA THA IBNE HASAN KA SEHRA
english translation text: THE SON OF HASAN’S SEHRA HAS BEEN COVERED IN DUST

arabic text: LARYA UTHA SAKINA ZAYNAB KE PAAS LAYI
english translation text: PICKING UP THE PIECES SAKINA BRINGS IT TO ZAYNAB

arabic text: PAAMAL HO RAHI SHABBAR TERI NISHANI
english translation text: THAT WHICH WAS A REMINDER OF SHABBAR(I.HASAN) IS BEING TRAMPLED

arabic text: QASIM KI LAASH KAISE SHABBIR NE UTHAYI
english translation text: HOW DID SHABBIR (I.HUSAYN) LIFT THE BODY OF QASIM
